title: Tim Taylor and the 'adjustment team'
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Tim Taylor and the 'adjustment team', about unspecified at NASA, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And then there's Tim Taylor telling Pasulka that he was part of the quote-unquote adjustment team,

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels, in an episode about NASA and UFOs, mentions a man named Tim Taylor who told religion scholar Diana Pasulka that he was part of what he called the "adjustment team." Michels relays the claim without spelling out what the team did, but the phrase suggests a hidden group said to change or correct things behind the scenes.
